BiblicalUsage: To come to an end is what happens to the kingdoms of men in Nebuchadnezzar's dream: the stone cut without hands will break them and bring them to an end. The same word describes Nebuchadnezzar driven from men, eating grass until his reason returns. The end comes to kingdoms and to kings alike.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's end is God's end, and every kingdom that sets itself against Him will come to it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
